text:
anya: Quick FYI — qbringup on q4b-int4 shows a 2.3% BLEU drop on en->fr long-sum benchmark vs fp16 baseline. Looks like promptset coverage + tokenization edgecases.
sam: :eyes: that's worrying. Is this across all domains or concentrated on legal/finance longform?
mike: Ran a quick diff on the eval harness, it's concentrated in 'summarize-long' and 'doc-extract' buckets. Short dialogs OK.
anya: attaching quick note: may be KV-cache prefix truncation + dedupe fallout. I'll dump a failing sample set.
anya: ```
# quick extract cmd
python infra/eval/extract_failures.py --model q4b-int4 --baseline fp16 --suite en-fr-long --topk 200 --out /tmp/q4b_fails.json
```
julia: Can we get a golden relabel pass on the top 200? Labelops capacity is light but we can prioritize.
labelops-bot: incoming labeling job created: JOB-8729, size=200, priority=high, reviewer_pool=golden. Link: https://labels.redwood/jobs/JOB-8729
mike: also noticed a cluster of near-duplicates that may have biased the metric. Propose an embedding dedupe before labeling.
anya: Agreed. Proposal: embed-threshold 0.82 with faiss-knn 8. I'll run a pass and attach candidate ids.
sam: Sounds good. After dedupe, we should sample 100 holdouts for targeted manual QA and 100 for the golden set refresh.
julia: If labelops accepts, I'll queue the 100 golden candidates as a micro-golden update (need updated acceptance criteria doc).
anya: Updated acceptance snippet:
```
- task: en->fr long summary
- tolerance: BLEU delta <= 0.5 vs baseline
- strictness: 2 reviewers agree on preferred output
```
mike: One more thing — quantization noise seems to hit longer token spans. Could we surface token-length buckets in the eval dash? @infra-team
sam: Filed infra ticket: INFRA-5502 to add token-length heatmap to the qbringup dashboard.
labelops-bot: JOB-8729 status update: 0/200 started.
julia: I'll ping CS to throttle other label campaigns this week so we can finish the micro-golden quickly.
anya: After labeling, I'll run the eval harness + a focused regression test against adversarial prompts. If regression confirmed, rollback plan: route traffic to fp16 for the route and open a quant-bisect job.
mike: For the dedupe step, here's the command I used locally:
```
python scripts/embedding_dedupe.py --input /tmp/q4b_fails.json --threshold 0.82 --knn 8 --out /tmp/q4b_fails_dedup.json
```
sam: Thanks. Can someone add a small promptset augment where we include edge-case tokenization examples (unicode marks, long punctuation runs)? That might help the quant pattern.
anya: I'll assemble a 50-example augment today and add to the holdout. Will post when uploaded.
julia: Labelops: can you confirm ETA to start the job? We need to inform product.
labelops-bot: JOB-8729 status update: 50/200 claimed by reviewers (golden pool). ETA full completion ~36h.
sam: OK. If completion at ~36h, we'll schedule the rerun and a quick triage meeting tomorrow 10am PST. Invite: @mike @anya @julia
mike: added to calendar. Also tagging model-ops to prep a canary route for fallback.
anya: Thanks all. If dedupe+relabel fixes >1.0 BLEU gap, we can keep q4b-int4; otherwise we fallback to fp16 and open a deeper quant-bisect.
sam: :thumbsup:
